text: This is the Macro Cosmos Rail customer\nservice counter.

Is good food important?
Is quick service?\c
Or cheap prices?
Saying you want them all is being greedy!
All that cheering’s got me famished!\c\nIt’s hard to resist a good meal after using all\nthat energy!
Chairman Rose is involved in all sorts of\nbusiness endeavors, and they’re all for\r\nthe sake of the Galar region!

Trains just keep running on the rails...\c
Some people say living life without going off the
rails is boring, but I think keeping things on track
deserves more credit, too!
